<thought>From the spectrum, the dominant peak at m/z ≈ 100.05 is followed by a smaller M+1 peak at ~5.6 % intensity and rapidly decreasing higher isotopes. This pattern matches the expected 13C isotopic envelope for a molecule containing several carbon atoms (≈5 C gives ~5 % M+1). No other element shows a distinctive pattern (Cl, Br, S would give larger M+2 peaks). Therefore, carbon is the only element that can be definitively identified from the observed isotopic distribution.</thought>
<final_answer>['C']</final_answer>
